description: Change state in the running game, e.g. to set up a test: {"score": 300, "position:x": 40, "items:2": 5}. Paths may address members, array elements and dictionary keys. Values are converted to the existing type; all of them are validated first and nothing changes if one is invalid. Returns before/after per path.

node.description: Node in the running game: relative to the running scene (e.g. 'Player') or absolute (e.g. '/root/Main/Player'). Default: the running scene root.

name: game_set
title: Set values in running game
